newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end off 0.36 pct tracking Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end off 0.36 pct tracking Wall St.

text.p: Brazil stocks ended off 0.36 percent in thin trade, tracking Wall Street's 50-point drop on fears the Federal Reserve would soon raise interest rates.
"We are worried about U.S. interest rates. Our market is tracking the Dow," a trader said.
The Bovespa index of the 52 most traded shares fell 229 points to close at 62,540 points. Turnover was thin at 239.3 million reais ($235.2 million).
The Dow industrials index closed unofficialy at 5607, down 50 points, as investors worried about a U.S. rate hike that could based on Friday's payroll and wage report.
